strip.upcoming: The meeting takes place on {when}. The agenda is already here; the transcript and the summaries are added after the meeting.
strip.upcomingNoAgenda: The meeting takes place on {when}. The agenda appears here as soon as it is published.
strip.live: The meeting is in progress. It started at {time}. The transcript arrives here a few hours after it ends.
strip.waiting: The meeting took place on {date}. We are waiting for the recording; transcription starts as soon as it is published.
strip.transcribing: We are transcribing the meeting. The transcript arrives in a few hours; the summaries follow after the review.
strip.review: The transcript is available. It was produced automatically and a person is reviewing it. Summaries, statements per speaker and the items raised before and outside the agenda:
strip.reviewHidden: The transcript was produced automatically and a person is reviewing it. It is published, with the summaries and the statements per speaker, after the review:
strip.archive: There is no transcript for this meeting. The agenda and the decisions are available.
strip.postponed: The meeting of {date} was postponed. When the municipality sets the new meeting, you will find it in the list of meetings.
strip.cancelled: The meeting of {date} was cancelled and did not take place. The agenda stays here for reference.
strip.closedToPublic: The meeting was held behind closed doors, with no public broadcast. The agenda and the decisions are available.
strip.byCirculation: The meeting was held by circulation, with a written vote. There is no video and no transcript; the agenda and the decisions are available.

pendingSections.title: Before and outside the agenda
pendingSections.body: The items raised before and outside the agenda appear after the transcript is reviewed.

summary.before: The summary is written automatically after the meeting, once the transcript is reviewed.
summary.review: The summary is written after the transcript is reviewed.

statements.before: The statements per speaker are drawn from the transcript, after the meeting.
statements.review: The statements per speaker are added after the transcript is reviewed.

facts.sessionNumber: {kind, select, regular {Regular meeting} urgent {Urgent meeting} other {Special meeting}} no. {number}

format.mixed: Mixed: in person and by teleconference
